normalization: Absolute study paths are replaced with <STUDY_ROOT>. Recorded rulesSha256 and promptSha256 refer to original GUIDANCE and worker prompts before path normalization. Each normalizedPromptSha256 hashes the stored normalized workerPrompt. Rules text in guidance.json is normalized; the version commits identify matching references/checker.
logNormalization: Saved npm-test.log strips trailing whitespace; study and repository paths in saved logs are normalized where present.
